    private void AnnounceProjectionState()
    {

        string group = "load:" + operation;
        if (_pendingLoadingGroup is { } prior && (!state.IsLoading || !string.Equals(prior, group, StringComparison.Ordinal)))
        { Announcements.Cancel(AnnouncementSurface, prior); _pendingLoadingGroup = null; }
        if (state.Error is not null)
        { SetFailureGroup(group); Announcements.Announce(AnnouncementSurface, group, "failure:" + (state.LastResultCorrelationId ?? operation), FcShellLocalizer["Am30QueryFailed"].Value, terminal: true); return; }
        if (state.IsLoading)
        { SetFailureGroup(null); _pendingLoadingGroup = group; Announcements.Announce(AnnouncementSurface, group, "loading", FcShellLocalizer["Am01Loading", "status overviews"].Value); return; }
        bool filtered = AnyRealFilterActive(CurrentGridSnapshot());

        {

            return;
        }
        SetFailureGroup(null);
        if (filtered) { return; }
        if (state.Items is null) { return; }
        if (state.Items.Count == 0)
        { Announcements.Announce(AnnouncementSurface, group, "empty:" + (state.LastResultCorrelationId ?? operation) + "|" + filtered, filtered ? FcShellLocalizer["Am27NoMatches", "status overviews"].Value : FcShellLocalizer["Am02Empty", "status overviews"].Value, terminal: true); return; }

        catch (global::Microsoft.JSInterop.JSDisconnectedException) { /* circuit teardown */ }
        catch (System.Threading.Tasks.TaskCanceledException) { /* circuit teardown */ }
        _dotNetRef?.Dispose();
        _dotNetRef = null;
        System.GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
    }

    private System.Threading.Tasks.Task HandleRowClickAsync(StatusOverviewProjection row)
    {
        if (row is null) { return System.Threading.Tasks.Task.CompletedTask; }
        object key = _itemKeyAccessor(row);
        var entry = ExpandedRowState.Value.GetEntry(_ephemeralViewKey);
        if (entry.HasValue && entry.Value.ItemKey.Equals(key))
        {
            Dispatcher.Dispatch(new global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.ExpandedRow.CollapseRowAction(_ephemeralViewKey));
        }
        else
        {
            Dispatcher.Dispatch(new global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.ExpandedRow.ExpandRowAction(_ephemeralViewKey, key));
        }

        return System.Threading.Tasks.Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private System.Threading.Tasks.Task HandleStatusOverviewRowClickAsync(StatusOverviewProjectionStatusOverviewRow row)
    {
        if (row is null) { return System.Threading.Tasks.Task.CompletedTask; }
        object key = row.StatusLabel;
        var entry = ExpandedRowState.Value.GetEntry(_ephemeralViewKey);
        if (entry.HasValue && entry.Value.ItemKey.Equals(key))
        {
            Dispatcher.Dispatch(new global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.ExpandedRow.CollapseRowAction(_ephemeralViewKey));
        }
        else
        {
            Dispatcher.Dispatch(new global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.ExpandedRow.ExpandRowAction(_ephemeralViewKey, key));
        }

        return System.Threading.Tasks.Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Contracts.Rendering.GridViewSnapshot? CurrentGridSnapshot()
        => GridNavigationState.Value.ViewStates.TryGetValue(_viewKey, out var snapshot) ? snapshot : null;

    private global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.DataGridNavigation.LoadedPageResult? CurrentFailedPage()
    {
        string request = PageRequestIdentity(CurrentGridSnapshot());
        var failed = LoadedPageState.Value.ResultsByPage
            .Where(entry => string.Equals(entry.Key.ViewKey, _viewKey, StringComparison.Ordinal)
                && entry.Value.Failed && string.Equals(entry.Value.RequestIdentity, request, StringComparison.Ordinal))
            .OrderBy(entry => entry.Key.Skip).Select(entry => entry.Value).FirstOrDefault();
        return failed ?? (LoadedPageState.Value.LastResultByKey.TryGetValue(_viewKey, out var last)
            && last.Failed && string.Equals(last.RequestIdentity, request, StringComparison.Ordinal) ? last : null);
    }

    private global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.DataGridNavigation.LoadedPageResult? PrimaryCompletedPage()
    {
        string request = PageRequestIdentity(CurrentGridSnapshot());
        if (LoadedPageState.Value.LastSuccessfulPrimaryByView.TryGetValue(_viewKey, out var page)
            && string.Equals(page.RequestIdentity, request, StringComparison.Ordinal)) { return page; }
        return LoadedPageState.Value.ResultsByPage.Count == 0
            && LoadedPageState.Value.LastResultByKey.TryGetValue(_viewKey, out var last)
            && !last.Failed && last.Skip == 0 && string.Equals(last.RequestIdentity, request, StringComparison.Ordinal) ? last : null;
    }

    private static System.Collections.Immutable.IImmutableDictionary<string, string> QueryFilters(global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Contracts.Rendering.GridViewSnapshot? snapshot)
    {
        if (snapshot is null) { return System.Collections.Immutable.ImmutableDictionary<string, string>.Empty; }
        return snapshot.Filters
            .Remove(global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Contracts.Rendering.ReservedFilterKeys.SearchKey)
            .Remove(global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Contracts.Rendering.VirtualizationReservedKeys.HiddenColumnsKey);
    }

    private static string? SearchQuery(global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Contracts.Rendering.GridViewSnapshot? snapshot)
        => snapshot is not null
            && snapshot.Filters.TryGetValue(global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Contracts.Rendering.ReservedFilterKeys.SearchKey, out var query)
            && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(query)
                ? query
                : null;

    private static string PageRequestIdentity(global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Contracts.Rendering.GridViewSnapshot? snapshot)
    {
        var identity = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
        static void AppendPart(System.Text.StringBuilder buffer, string? value)
        { if (value is null) { buffer.Append("-1:"); return; } buffer.Append(value.Length).Append(':').Append(value); }
        AppendPart(identity, snapshot?.SortColumn);
        identity.Append(snapshot?.SortDescending == true ? '1' : '0');
        AppendPart(identity, SearchQuery(snapshot));
        foreach (var filter in QueryFilters(snapshot).OrderBy(static entry => entry.Key, StringComparer.Ordinal))
        { AppendPart(identity, filter.Key); AppendPart(identity, filter.Value); }
        return identity.ToString();
    }

    private static System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyList<global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Contracts.Attributes.BadgeSlot> ActiveStatusSlots(global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Contracts.Rendering.GridViewSnapshot? snapshot)
    {
        if (snapshot is null
            || !snapshot.Filters.TryGetValue(global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Contracts.Rendering.ReservedFilterKeys.StatusKey, out var csv)
            || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(csv))
        {
            return System.Array.Empty<global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Contracts.Attributes.BadgeSlot>();
        }

        var slots = new System.Collections.Generic.List<global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Contracts.Attributes.BadgeSlot>();
        foreach (string part in csv.Split(',', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries | StringSplitOptions.TrimEntries))
        {
            if (System.Enum.TryParse<global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Contracts.Attributes.BadgeSlot>(part, ignoreCase: false, out var slot))
            {
                slots.Add(slot);
            }
        }

        return slots;
    }

    private static System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyList<StatusOverviewProjection> TemplateItems(System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyList<StatusOverviewProjection>? items, global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Contracts.Rendering.GridViewSnapshot? snapshot)
    {
        System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyList<StatusOverviewProjection> source = items ?? System.Array.Empty<StatusOverviewProjection>();
        var activeSlots = ActiveStatusSlots(snapshot);
        if (activeSlots.Count == 0)
        {
            return source;
        }

        var activeSet = new System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Contracts.Attributes.BadgeSlot>(activeSlots);
        return source.Where(row => RowMatchesActiveStatus(row, activeSet)).ToList();
    }

    private static System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable<StatusOverviewProjection> StatusFilteredItems(System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable<StatusOverviewProjection> items, global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Contracts.Rendering.GridViewSnapshot? snapshot)
    {
        var activeSlots = ActiveStatusSlots(snapshot);
        if (activeSlots.Count == 0)
        {
            return items;
        }

        var activeSet = new System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Contracts.Attributes.BadgeSlot>(activeSlots);
        return items.Where(row => RowMatchesActiveStatus(row, activeSet));
    }

    private static bool RowMatchesActiveStatus(StatusOverviewProjection row, System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Contracts.Attributes.BadgeSlot> activeSlots)
    {
        global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Contracts.Attributes.BadgeSlot? __StatusSlot = StatusSlotForStatus(row.Status.ToString());
        if (__StatusSlot.HasValue && activeSlots.Contains(__StatusSlot.Value))
        {
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private static global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Contracts.Attributes.BadgeSlot? StatusSlotForStatus(string? value)
        => value switch
        {
            "Open" => global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Contracts.Attributes.BadgeSlot.Info,
            "InProgress" => global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Contracts.Attributes.BadgeSlot.Warning,
            "Resolved" => global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Contracts.Attributes.BadgeSlot.Success,
            "Closed" => global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Contracts.Attributes.BadgeSlot.Neutral,
            _ => null,
        };

    private static string ProjectionTypeFromViewKey()
    {
        int separator = _viewKey.IndexOf(':');
        return separator >= 0 && separator < _viewKey.Length - 1 ? _viewKey[(separator + 1)..] : _viewKey;
    }

    private static string? EntityKeyFromItem(StatusOverviewProjection row)
    {
        object? key = _itemKeyAccessor(row);
        return key switch
        {
            null => null,
            string value when !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) => value,
            string => null,
            System.IFormattable formattable => formattable.ToString(null, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
            _ => key.ToString(),
        };
    }

    private static string? ExpectedStatusSlotFromItem(StatusOverviewProjection row)
        => row.Status.ToString();

    private static global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.PendingCommandRowIdentity? PendingCommandRowIdentityFor(StatusOverviewProjection row)
    {
        string? entityKey = EntityKeyFromItem(row);
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(entityKey))
        {
            return null;
        }

        return new global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.PendingCommandRowIdentity(
            ProjectionTypeFromViewKey(),
            _viewKey,
            entityKey,
            ExpectedStatusSlotFromItem(row));
    }

    private void DismissMaterializedIndicators(System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable<StatusOverviewProjection>? items)
    {
        if (items is null) { return; }
        foreach (var item in items)
        {
            string? entityKey = EntityKeyFromItem(item);
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(entityKey))
            {
                NewItemIndicators.DismissMaterialized(_viewKey, entityKey);
            }
        }
    }

    private void RenderNewItemIndicators(global::Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Rendering.RenderTreeBuilder builder)
    {
        foreach (var entry in NewItemIndicators.Snapshot(_viewKey))
        {
            builder.OpenComponent<global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.Components.DataGrid.FcNewItemIndicator>(0);
            builder.SetKey(entry.EntityKey);
            builder.CloseComponent();
        }
    }

    private void RegisterVisibleProjectionLane()
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(RenderContext?.TenantId))
        {
            return;
        }

        var snapshot = CurrentGridSnapshot();
        var filters = QueryFilters(snapshot);
        var searchQuery = SearchQuery(snapshot);
        int take = ShellOptions.Value.VirtualizationServerSideThreshold;
        string laneKey = string.Join("\u001d", RenderContext.TenantId, ProjectionTypeFromViewKey(), "0", take.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), snapshot?.SortColumn ?? string.Empty, snapshot?.SortDescending == true ? "desc" : "asc", searchQuery ?? string.Empty, string.Join("\u001f", filters.OrderBy(static kv => kv.Key, StringComparer.Ordinal).Select(static kv => kv.Key + "\u001e" + kv.Value)));
        if (string.Equals(_registeredProjectionFallbackLaneKey, laneKey, StringComparison.Ordinal))
        {
            return;
        }

        if (_registeredProjectionFallbackLaneKey is not null)
        {
            NewItemIndicators.DismissForFilterChange(_viewKey);
        }

        _projectionFallbackLaneRegistration?.Dispose();
        _projectionFallbackLaneRegistration = ProjectionFallbackRefreshScheduler.RegisterLane(new global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.ProjectionConnection.ProjectionFallbackLane(
            _viewKey,
            ProjectionTypeFromViewKey(),
            RenderContext.TenantId,
            0,
            take,
            filters,
            snapshot?.SortColumn,
            snapshot?.SortDescending ?? false,
            searchQuery));
        _registeredProjectionFallbackLaneKey = laneKey;
    }

    private string GridHostClass()
    {
        if (ReconciliationSweepState.Value.MarkersByViewKey.TryGetValue(_viewKey, out var marker) && marker.ExpiresAt > TimeProvider.GetUtcNow())
        {
            return "fc-datagrid-host fc-projection-grid fc-reconciliation-sweep";
        }

        return "fc-datagrid-host fc-projection-grid";
    }

    private static bool AnyRealFilterActive(global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Contracts.Rendering.GridViewSnapshot? snapshot)
    {
        if (snapshot is null) { return false; }
        foreach (var filter in snapshot.Filters)
        {
            if ((!filter.Key.StartsWith("__", StringComparison.Ordinal) || filter.Key is global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Contracts.Rendering.ReservedFilterKeys.SearchKey or global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Contracts.Rendering.ReservedFilterKeys.StatusKey) && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(filter.Value))
            {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static string[] ResolveHiddenColumns(global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Contracts.Rendering.GridViewSnapshot? snapshot)
        => System.Array.Empty<string>();

    private static string Truncate(string value, int maxLength)
        => maxLength <= 0 ? string.Empty : value.Length <= maxLength ? value : string.Concat(value.AsSpan(0, maxLength - 1), "\u2026");

    private static string HumanizeEnumLabel(string value)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
        {
            return value;
        }

        var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder(value.Length + 10);

        for (int i = 0; i < value.Length; i++)
        {
            char c = value[i];

            if (i == 0)
            {
                sb.Append(char.ToUpperInvariant(c));
                continue;
            }

            bool isUpper = c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z';
            bool prevIsUpper = value[i - 1] >= 'A' && value[i - 1] <= 'Z';
            bool prevIsLower = value[i - 1] >= 'a' && value[i - 1] <= 'z';
            bool prevIsDigit = value[i - 1] >= '0' && value[i - 1] <= '9';

            if (isUpper && prevIsLower)
            {
                sb.Append(' ');
                sb.Append(c);
            }
            else if (isUpper && prevIsUpper && i + 1 < value.Length)
            {
                char next = value[i + 1];
                bool nextIsLower = next >= 'a' && next <= 'z';
                if (nextIsLower && CountConsecutiveUppersBefore(value, i) + 1 >= 3)
                {
                    sb.Append(' ');
                }

                sb.Append(c);
            }
            else if (isUpper && prevIsDigit)
            {
                sb.Append(' ');
                sb.Append(c);
            }
            else
            {
                sb.Append(c);
            }
        }

        return sb.ToString();
    }

    private static int CountConsecutiveUppersBefore(string value, int index)
    {
        int count = 0;
        for (int i = index - 1; i >= 0; i--)
        {
            if (value[i] >= 'A' && value[i] <= 'Z')
            {
                count++;
            }
            else
            {
                break;
            }
        }

        return count;
    }
